column1: # Latin names for the 36 CUB-200 classes whose English name has no exact match among iNat-2021's
# common names (the other 164 are mapped automatically, see build_dataset.py relabel).
# Columns: CUB label (as cleaned in configs/cub200_val.jsonl) <TAB> scientific name <TAB> note
# Notes: "rename"   = same species, iNat uses a different/newer English name
#        "genus"    = CUB class is a genus or a lumped group; the genus name is used
#        "dominant" = CUB class is ambiguous but its images are (almost) all this species
#        "absent"   = species is not among iNat-2021's 10,000 classes; standard binomial used, in the
#                     genus spelling iNat-2021 uses (e.g. Phalacrocorax, not Urile, for cormorants)
